comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
The light brown one is +1 Dye Trading. The immigrant Zhang En has the recipe, which is the same ingredients as in the Taiwanese sewing book and is also r8 sewing.

To recruit Zhang En to your colony, you do the immigration quest "Letter from eastern europe" from an eastern European company administration. It requires you to deliver 20 Tyrian Purple to Hangzhou.

part of the memorial album Immigration Attraction (No.2)
